description: Given a topic, suggest distinct content angles informed by what performs well in the user's scoped data. Pulls top-performing historical posts as context and calls OpenAI to generate 5 concrete angles. Costs 5 credits per call. Pass `profile_id` to scope to a tracked profile, `collection_id` to scope to a collection, or neither to use the user's full library.

collection_id.description: Optional post_collections.id (scopes to this collection's members)

profile_id.description: Optional tracked profile ID (scopes to this profile's posts)

topic.description: Topic or theme to generate angles for (e.g. 'onboarding new hires', 'pricing strategy')

name: suggest_angles
title: Suggest Angles
